definitions.gloss: to request, to ask (someone to do something)
definitions.explanation: To politely ask someone to do something or to make a request.

definitions.gloss: to pray for, to wish for
definitions.explanation: To pray or make a wish, often at a shrine or temple.

notes:
お{願|ねが}いする is the polite way to make a request. It is the honorific form of ⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ (to ask/request) and is essential for daily polite communication.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧します: Please / I'd like to request this (extremely common)
- ⟦よろしくお{願|ねが}いします→よろしくお願いします：23566_yoroshikuonegaishimasu⟧: Please take care of this / Nice to meet you / I look forward to working with you
- ⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: I have a favor to ask
- ⟦ぜひ→ぜひ：00911_zehi⟧お⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧したい: I'd really like to ask you

SENSE 2 (PRAYER):
At shrines and temples, お{願|ねが}いする means to pray for something or make a wish: ⟦{神様|かみさま}→神様：00161_kamisama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{願|ねが}いする (to pray to God/the gods).

REGISTER:
お{願|ねが}いする is polite and appropriate in most situations. For casual requests, use ⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ instead. For very formal written requests, ⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧ is used.
